About Athle

Fashion for Everyone

Athle Designing Studio is a local fashion and custom-printing studio in Gaighata, Narikela, North 24 Parganas. Our catalogue covers men’s, women’s and kids’ T-shirts, shirts and hoodies, along with custom printing for couples, birthdays, events, colleges, sports teams and businesses.

Our promise: your design, your style, your identity — printed with care.
